notes.scope: Combat weapons and weapon-like combat tools. Excludes utility-only Harpoon, boats, potions, companions, bosses, and class rows as primary subjects.

item.name: Hatchet
item.howToGet: Every run starts with the Hatchet unless the equipped class starts with a stronger melee weapon.
item.notes: Default close-range blade and early chopping tool. Replaced when you pick up a stronger melee.
item.cardSummary: The free starting melee every survivor gets until a class or better blade replaces it.

item.name: Machete
item.howToGet: Common chest loot, Fisherman trades, or start as Zookeeper or Swordsman.
item.notes: Strong early-game melee for raft night raids before mid-run blades show up.
item.cardSummary: The first real blade upgrade for most runs, available from loot, trades, or two mid-cost classes.

item.name: Poku Poku
item.howToGet: Sometimes drops from Boku Poku enemies, or start as Battle Buku.
item.cardSummary: Mid melee with a fixed 20 damage readout, tied to Boku Poku fights or the Battle Buku starter kit.

item.name: Swordfish Sword
item.howToGet: Trade a Swordfish steak with the Fisherman for this mid-run blade.
item.notes: Guides list this as a clear mid-game melee step-up after the Machete.
item.cardSummary: Fisherman trade reward that upgrades your melee once you can cook and trade Swordfish steak.

item.name: Ghost Cutlass
item.howToGet: Always inside the green chest at the Pirate Stronghold after you clear the pirates there.
item.notes: The same green chest also yields a galleon bell. Late-run melee option before full ranged switch.
item.cardSummary: Guaranteed stronghold blade with 35 damage from the Pirate Stronghold green chest.

item.name: Energy Sword
item.howToGet: Occasional drop from Alien Warriors, or start as Alien Warrior (also called Alien Sword).
item.notes: Late-game melee alternative to Ghost Cutlass when alien content is active.
item.cardSummary: Alien-route melee that can drop from Alien Warriors or arrive as the Alien Warrior class starter.

item.name: Claymore
item.howToGet: Exclusive starting weapon of the Knight class.
item.notes: Knight also starts with Knight Armor for damage reduction.
item.cardSummary: Knight-only heavy melee starter built for armored close-range tanking.

item.name: Holy Sword
item.howToGet: Exclusive starting weapon of the Hero class.
item.notes: Premium melee pick that guides treat as the top pure-melee class blade.
item.cardSummary: Hero-only premium sword for durable melee runs that start strong from day one.

item.name: Saber
item.howToGet: Exclusive starting weapon of the Chaos Master class (also called Laser Sword).
item.notes: Chaos Master pairs the Saber with Chaos Lightning and mobility perks.
item.cardSummary: Chaos Master exclusive laser saber for hybrid melee-magic class loadouts.

item.name: Flintlock
item.howToGet: Fisherman trades, chests, Traveling Merchant purchases, or start as Crewmate or Sharpshooter.
item.notes: Solid early gun with a slower fire rate that falls off once better ranged options arrive.
item.cardSummary: Budget pistol for early island and raft defense, widely lootable and used by two gun classes.

item.name: Blunderbuss
item.howToGet: Fisherman trades, chests, Traveling Merchant purchases, or start as Pirate.
item.notes: High per-shot damage shotgun-style gun; Pirate ammo management matters early.
item.cardSummary: Heavy close-range gun with 60 damage per shot from loot routes or the Pirate class.

item.name: Rifle
item.howToGet: Found in chests or bought from the Traveling Merchant. Some weapon guides also list it on Pirate loadouts, but class pages emphasize Blunderbuss as the Pirate starter.
item.notes: Treat Pirate starter claims as secondary until class UI confirms both guns.
item.cardSummary: Mid ranged rifle from chests and merchants with a sourced 30 damage per shot.

item.name: Revolver
item.howToGet: Treasure chests, Corrupted Officer drops, or start as Cowboy.
item.notes: Ammo runs out quickly on Cowboy if you do not manage shots.
item.cardSummary: 25-damage pistol route through treasure loot, Corrupted Officer, or the Cowboy class.

item.name: Boomstick
item.howToGet: First open of the green ghost pirate chest on the Ghost Galleon always rewards a Boomstick.
item.notes: Later Ghost Galleon chest opens can shift toward Galleon boat rewards instead of repeating the Boomstick.
item.cardSummary: Ghost Galleon green-chest gun locked behind the first galleon chest clear.

item.name: Riptide
item.howToGet: Start as Harpooner, or claim the purple chest on the mushroom treasure island, which always rewards Riptide.
item.notes: Harpoon-style ranged weapon with a slow fire rate; budget option rather than a top-end gun.
item.cardSummary: Harpoon-class ranged tool with a guaranteed mushroom-island purple chest route and a 5 damage readout.

item.name: Assault Rifle
item.howToGet: Exclusive starting weapon of the Soldier class.
item.notes: Comes with Assault Rifle ammo on Soldier; later levels add Military Armor and more ammo.
item.cardSummary: Soldier-only automatic starter for mid-cost gun pressure on night raids and islands.

item.name: Dual Pistols
item.howToGet: Exclusive starting weapons of the Raider class.
item.notes: Raider grows magazine size from kills and can restock pistol ammo from defeated enemies.
item.cardSummary: Raider exclusive dual pistols built for sustained gunfights with kill-based ammo sustain.

item.name: Ray Gun
item.howToGet: Obtained from the Alien Mothership route, or start as Alien Overlord.
item.notes: Guides often call this the best overall ranged weapon, especially with gun-damage classes.
item.cardSummary: High-damage alien gun with a 50 damage readout from the mothership path or Alien Overlord.

item.name: Squid Laser Gun
item.howToGet: Defeat the Ancient Squid, or start as the Ancient Squid class.
item.notes: Ancient Squid class levels add laser damage and stop overheating at max level.
item.cardSummary: Endgame laser weapon tied to the Ancient Squid fight and matching premium class starter.

item.name: Corrupt Minigun
item.howToGet: Exclusive starting weapon of the Minigunner class.
item.notes: Automatic wave-clear option; Minigunner is a high Pearl cost class with HP and gun damage levels.
item.cardSummary: Minigunner-only automatic minigun for shredding enemy waves and boss health bars.

item.name: Magma Staff
item.howToGet: Defeat the Magma Golem / Lord of Lava boss route for the guaranteed boss chest reward, or start as Fire Mage.
item.notes: Strong AoE boss weapon limited by fire rate; keep distance while casting.
item.cardSummary: Fire magic staff with 25 damage per shot from the volcano boss chest or Fire Mage starter.

item.name: Ice Staff
item.howToGet: Defeat the Yeti boss for the guaranteed ice chest staff, or start as Ice Mage.
item.notes: Boss-weapon alternative to Magma Staff with the same keep-your-distance play pattern.
item.cardSummary: Ice magic staff from the Yeti boss chest or Ice Mage class for premium ranged magic damage.

item.name: Egg Bomb
item.howToGet: Exclusive combat tool of the Battle Bunny class (Egg Bomb / Egg Grenades).
item.notes: Battle Bunny gains more Egg Grenades from enemies and chests and boosts explosive damage as the class levels.
item.cardSummary: Battle Bunny exclusive explosive combat tools for mobility-focused explosive pressure.
